title: Bypass the "Impossible" Red Border in Minecraft PE (it actually works)
topic: We’ve all been there: trying to drag your buttons to the edge of the screen only for that red border to stop you cold.
description: We’ve all been there: trying to drag your buttons to the edge of the screen only for that red border to stop you cold. It ruins your custom layout and your gameplay. But what if you could break the rules? In today’s short tutorial, I’m revealing a secret method to glitch your buttons past the "Lakshman Rekha" of Minecraft PE. It’s simple, fast, and Mojang probably doesn't want you to know about it!
